facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; no restrictive controls on foreign income.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Not needed: Ecuador uses the US dollar, so local accounts are in dollars.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the SRI (Servicio de Rentas Internas); steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: RUC (Taxpayer's Unique Registry) from the SRI.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents are taxed on foreign income too, with a credit.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% VAT; domestic threshold and export rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: RIMPE: a simplified regime for income up to USD 300,000.

watch_out.text: Sending money abroad costs a 5% capital exit tax (ISD).
The SRI moves taxpayers between RIMPE categories yearly; check your RUC.
